name: ziggy-app
description: Ziggy AI native apps (Android, Android TV, iPhone, iPad): a Tauri 2 shell around https://ziggy-ai.fr

scripts.android:build: tauri android build --apk --aab --target aarch64 armv7 x86_64
scripts.check: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo clippy --target aarch64-linux-android -- -D warnings && bash ../scripts/check-ios-on-linux.sh
